messages:
Ava (Eng Ops): Hey team — quick heads up, the audience feed is cutting for some viewers on the staging stream. Seeing gaps ~10s. Can someone check encoder health?
Samir (Platform): Looking at the host logs now. encoder01 dropped frames at 1925002455. Reconnecting...
Ava (Eng Ops): @Samir thx. Can we hot-swap to backup recorder if it doesn't come back in 60s? :grimacing:
Samir (Platform): On it. @Liam can you verify backup node is warmed? I see it marked "standby" in nomad.
Liam (Infra): Backup node is up but NDI bridge needs a quick auth refresh. Running `ssh infra@backup 'systemctl restart ndi-bridge'` now.
Priya (Product): Heads-up for hosts: if you see broken frames, ask attendees to refresh the stream. We'll announce on stage once stable.
Nora (Comms): I'll prepare a 1-sentence slide we can show: "We're experiencing brief streaming interruptions — working on a fix."
OpsBot: encoder01 status: RESTARTING -> HEALTHY (1925002532)
Samir (Platform): Encoder restarted but we got a 503 from transcoder pool. Checking routing rules.
Liam (Infra): Transcoder pool out-of-sync with load balancer. Pushing quick route fix: `lbctl set-backend transcode-prod +1`
Ava (Eng Ops): Timeline? We should have captions back before the Q&A segment.
Samir (Platform): Route fix applied, packets flowing. Captions service still lagging ~5s behind. Probable backlog on speech worker.
Priya (Product): OK — let's move Q&A 3 mins later, call a soft hold. Can hosts keep taking questions in the meantime?
Ava (Eng Ops): Yes — tell hosts to keep the mic open but pause the formal Q&A, we'll ping when ready. :thumbsup:
Nora (Comms): Announcement posted in #general and pinned to the event doc.
Samir (Platform): Captions workers scaled up: +2 instances. Lag dropped to ~1s. Monitoring.
OpsBot: captions-worker-7 scaled -> READY (1925002650)
Ava (Eng Ops): Nicely done. Replay is intact; local recorder has continuous file. We'll stitch if any attendees missed a chunk.
Priya (Product): For follow-up: can we record timestamps of where blanks were so we can clip and notify impacted users?
Liam (Infra): I'll drop a marker in the recording at 1925002470-1925002520 and push metadata to S3 with tag event=allhands_2031.
Samir (Platform): Noted — I'll add a note in the runbook about the NDI auth flake. Maybe rotate keys more frequently.
Nora (Comms): After the meeting I'll draft the post-event note and include an apology and link to the full recording + timestamps. 
Ava (Eng Ops): Thanks everyone. Small retrospective item: add an automatic failover test to preflight checklist.
Priya (Product): Agreed. I'll add to the action items: 1) preflight failover test 2) doc update for hosts 3) clip + send to attendees.
Samir (Platform): +1. I'll create the follow-up ticket after this.
Liam (Infra): All good from infra side. Leaving the backup warmed for the postmortem.
Ava (Eng Ops): Closing the loop — stream stable, Q&A resuming in 90s. Ping me if anything else pops up.
Priya (Product): Resume Q&A in 90s confirmed. Thanks team :rocket:
